note: All inputs are existing committed research files except the two report-only Yahoo October-2026 files, downloaded for this study on 2026-10-22. SHA-256 computed in this worktree. No production file is read or written.

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.source_url: Yahoo Finance chart API daily bars, as recorded by stress_robustness_v1
data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.used_by: fe_data.load(): QQQ/SPY/QLD open, close, dividend; QQQ closes drive the overlay, the E2 vote and K's weight; the synthetic QLD* 2x leg

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.source_url: FRED DTB3 (3-Month Treasury Bill, secondary market rate), as recorded by stress_robustness_v1
data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.used_by: QLD* financing; the October-2026 extension's rate series (forward-filled)

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.source_url: CBRT USD/TRY forex buying rate, as recorded by after_tax_tr_v1
data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.used_by: RunEnv.fx: USD/TRY conversion of gains, tax payments and terminal liquidation

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.source_url: TUIK YI-UFE monthly index (TURPPDMMINMEI, chained), as recorded by after_tax_tr_v1
data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.used_by: YI-UFE indexation and deflated tariff ceilings in fe_tax

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_gspc.csv.source_url: Yahoo ^GSPC daily closes as recorded by ewma_band_v1

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_index.csv.used_by: gate G7 windows M1-M5 and the pooled OOS bootstrap (G8)

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_tb3ms.csv.source_url: FRED TB3MS as recorded by ewma_band_v1
data/historical/ewma_band_v1_tb3ms.csv.used_by: gate G7: pre-1954 T-bill rate for the M2 window

data/historical/short_term_reentry_v1_qq.overlap_check: 13 shared sessions 2026-09-11..2026-09-29: QQQ closes identical to 3e-5, no dividend differences
data/historical/short_term_reentry_v1_qq.used_by: stage EPI only (report-only October 2026 episode); never a gate

data/historical/short_term_reentry_v1_ql.used_by: stage EPI context (real QLD buy-and-hold), not a strategy input

implementation.research/fast_engine: restored from archive/research/fast-engine-v1-2026-10 (unchanged; simulation, tax, bootstrap)
implementation.research/band_h2_combo_v1: restored from archive/research/fast-engine-v1-2026-10 (K harness / parity reference)
implementation.research/short_term_oracle_v1/engine/fe_: the parent branch's bootstrap extension (exogenous per-path targets, masked prices); imported unchanged
implementation.research/short_term_reentry_v1/engine/fe: new: the numba overlay signal kernel (target construction only)
